29/G.goal: Explain how audio contributes to immersive XR experiences by connecting sound's physical properties and human hearing to believability and presence.
29/G.achieves: Equips the learner with foundational human-factors knowledge for understanding and later addressing the auditory dimension in XR system design and implementation.

29/O1.goal: Explain how audio supports believable and present XR experiences by complementing visual information.
29/O1.achieves: Gives the learner a basis for recognizing audio as a key human factor when evaluating or designing immersive XR systems.

29/O2.goal: Trace how sound waves are physically characterized and converted by the human auditory system into neural impulses.
29/O2.achieves: Provides the physical and perceptual foundations needed to understand why and how audio shapes immersion in XR.
